policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Anderson's fourteen goals have come from eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Jonas Zethofer's three; they have conceded six.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Newberry win at last, and Emory & Henry hold Anderson in the only match of theirs to carry a result.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every Emory & Henry match but Tuesday's, the latest of them at home to Palm Beach Atlantic.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Newberry's win at Bob Jones was their first of the season; they have scored seven and conceded sixteen in one win and five defeats.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Catawba have scored fourteen and conceded three in four wins and a draw; Alex Payton has four of the goals from sixteen shots.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Wingate have scored twelve and conceded four in three wins and two defeats, and followed a home defeat to Francis Marion with a win at Middle Georgia State.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Carson-Newman's Elijah Buford has made eighteen saves and conceded two goals.
